subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should OpenClaw accept Gateway-owned cron provenance and cron-aware canonical agent deletion as part of the experimental Claws lifecycle stack?
rationale: This is a new persisted lifecycle model spanning Gateway scheduling, shared state, export, and canonical agent deletion; implementation review cannot determine whether that product boundary should become the supported experimental direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed restacked cron slice
options.body: Keep the Gateway-owned ownership model, restack it on accepted prerequisites, and require live Gateway proof plus upgrade-path review before landing.

options.title: Defer the lifecycle model
options.body: Pause this slice until maintainers choose the broader Claws ownership and agent-deletion contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed restacked cron slice
recommendation.body: Keep the Gateway-owned ownership model, restack it on accepted prerequisites, and require live Gateway proof plus upgrade-path review before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review feedback and assignment directly cover the canonical agent-deletion and durable-state boundary at issue.
